candidates.title: MAPS: Memory-Aware Predictive Scheduling Framework for Large Language Model Serving
candidates.reason: Fresh disaggregated-serving scheduler: device-assisted output-length prediction plus uncertainty-aware calibration and hierarchical global/local decode scheduling; reports 42.6% average latency and up to 84.8% tail-latency reduction.

candidates.title: HBFSim: Fast and Faithful Simulation of High-Bandwidth Flash Under Real GPU Execution
candidates.reason: Directly relevant to hierarchical memory and emerging high-bandwidth flash for LLM inference; executes real vLLM/Qwen3 GPU workload while imposing measured HBF timing/capacity/thermal effects.

candidates.title: What Matters for Aggressive Decoding-Time KV Eviction? Temporal Aggregation and Ranking Preservation
candidates.reason: KV-cache retention study isolates temporal aggregation and ranking preservation; introduces InertiaKV/InertiaKV-Lazy and reports 1.34-1.46x decode throughput for periodic refresh.
